info.title: DStudio Daemon API
info.description:
Data gateway for AI agents. Humans configure datasources and datasets through a GUI; agents consume them via a uniform HTTP API.

## Authentication

**Management API** (`/manage/*`): Bearer token from `~/.dstudio/config.toml`.

**Live API** (`/a/*`) and **Actions API** (`/act/*`): Per-agent bearer tokens created via the management API.

The health endpoint (`GET /manage/health`) is unauthenticated.

get.summary: List datasets available to this agent
Get a single item by ID
Get the schema of a dataset
Poll the state of a queued approval

post.summary: Invoke an action. Requires Idempotency-Key header. Returns 200 (executed), 202 (pending approval), 409 (idempotency conflict), or 429 (rate limited).

get.summary: List action bindings for an agent

post.summary: Bind an action to an agent

get.summary: List dataset bindings for an agent

post.summary: Bind a dataset to an agent
Generate CLI config for an agent
Generate MCP config for an agent

get.summary: List skill installations for an agent

post.summary: Install a skill to a folder

get.summary: Get per-dataset metrics for an agent

post.summary: Create an agent token (the raw token is returned only once)
Set force-simulate flag on a token
Approve a pending request (executes the action inline)

get.summary: Get dataset with fields and filters

post.summary: Introspect dataset fields from the source

get.summary: List REST spec endpoints (from OpenAPI spec)

post.summary: Update scopes on an OAuth connection
Start an OAuth flow (returns auth_url to open in browser)

delete.summary: Delete AI API key from secret store

action_type.description: Stable machine identifier (e.g. `create_draft`). Unique per datasource.

approval_ttl_seconds.description:
How long a queued approval lives before auto-deny. `None` means approvals never expire
and must be explicitly resolved.

params_schema.description:
JSON Schema for request params. Used by the daemon for validation, by generators for
SKILL/MCP/CLI contracts, and by the simulator to shape fake responses.

result_schema.description: JSON Schema for the response body.

threshold_config.description: Action-specific threshold conditions; only consulted when `policy_kind = Threshold`.

expires_at.description: Wall-clock time after which a still-pending row is swept to `Expired` by the daemon.

params_hash.description:
SHA-256 hex of `params`. Lets an approver detect and reject tampering between queue
and execute, and lets the idempotency layer 409 on same-key / different-body.

resolved_by.description: Free-text approver identifier from the UI session; no FK.

result.description:
Connector response on successful execution, or a structured error envelope on failure.
`None` while the approval is still pending.

token_id.description:
Raw token id that issued the call. `None` if the token was rotated/deleted after the
row was written — history survives token deletion.

agent_type.description:
Free-form tag identifying the consumer harness or product family (e.g.
`openclaw`, `cowork`, `hermes`). Lets the UI group and filter agents
without enforcing a fixed vocabulary.

mission.description:
Longform description of what the agent is for — complements the short
`description` field. Not propagated into SKILL.md automatically.

owner.description: Free-form owner identifier (name, team, email). Not an FK.

status.description:
Lifecycle status — typically `draft`, `active`, or `archived`, but kept
as a free string so operators can invent their own values.

pinned_params.description:
Fixed parameter values merged into the agent's request at invocation
time. The agent cannot override these — they are forcefully applied
after the agent's payload is received. Used to lock parameters like
`project_key` so an agent is constrained to a specific project.

rate_limit_count.description:
Per-binding rate cap, expressed as `count` invocations per
`rate_limit_period_seconds`. Both must be `Some` for the limit to apply.

template.description:
Freeform template (e.g. a draft email skeleton) the agent should follow
when crafting params for this action. Purely prompt guidance — the
daemon doesn't substitute or validate against it. Rendered into SKILL.md
and config.json so connectors can surface it to the model.

AgentSkillInstallation.description:
A place on disk where an agent's `SKILL.md` has been installed outside its
own `<data_dir>/agents/<name>/skills/dstudio/` home — e.g. `~/.hermes/skills`.
The daemon owns these files: every resync rewrites `<folder_path>/dstudio/SKILL.md`.

folder_path.description: Parent directory picked by the user (the `dstudio/` namespace dir lives below it).

force_simulate.description:
When true, every action invoked via this token is rerouted to the simulator regardless
of the request-level `simulated` flag. Intended for staging tokens that must never hit
a real external system.

data_kind.description:
Coarse content tag (e.g. "messages", "events", "records"). Helps agents pick the
right dataset when several are bound.

description.description:
Human-authored description. Consumed by skill generation and exposed to agents so
they can tell similar datasets apart ("customer records" vs. "prospect leads").

enabled.description: When false, the dataset is paused: serving and sync are skipped but the config is kept.

max_page_bytes.description:
Hard cap on the serialized byte size of a single response page. When the
items payload exceeds this, the daemon returns 413 with guidance to use
`?fields=` or a smaller `?limit=`. `None` means no cap.

max_rows_per_query.description:
Per-dataset cap on rows returned by a single `list` or `search` call. `None` means
fall back to the global 1000-row hard limit applied by the daemon.

pii_scan_at.description: Wall-clock time of the last PII scan, or `None` if never scanned.

credential_detected.description:
Set by the scanner when this field's sample values match a known
credential shape (API keys, JWTs, etc.). Informational — surfaced in
the UI as a red banner so operators notice credential leakage.

pii_class.description:
PII classification from the last scan, or `None` if the field has
never been classified. Values: direct_identifier, quasi_identifier,
contact, health, financial, non_pii.

pii_policy.description:
Redaction policy applied at serve time. One of `none`, `mask`, `drop`,
`generalize`. Defaults to `none` — unclassified fields are served
as-is.

searchable.description:
When false, this field's values are excluded from `/a/.../search` matching — i.e. a
`q` hit on this column does not return the row. Does not affect `/list` or pre-filters.

sortable.description:
When false, agents cannot order results by this field — the `sort_by`
param treats it as unknown (silent no-op). Operator-facing override that
only *withdraws* sortability; effective sortability is additionally gated
by the connector's capability and field visibility.

connection_id.description:
Optional reference to a shared OAuth connection. When set, OAuth client credentials
(client_id/client_secret) come from the connection and the datasource.config only
holds non-credential fields (e.g. calendar_id).

read_only.description: When true, all write actions on this datasource are blocked.

sorted_by.description:
Echo of the field the result set was actually ordered by (a
`display_name`). Present only when a sort was honored; its *absence* when
the agent asked to sort signals a silent no-op (ordering undefined).

daemon_url.description:
Override the daemon URL written into config.json / SKILL.md. Defaults to
the daemon's own bind URL (e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9820).

scopes.description:
OAuth scopes requested during the authorisation flow. Empty means "use
the hardcoded per-datasource-type default" — we read this at auth-url
build time in the daemon, not at token-refresh time.
